title: Turkey Burgers with Avocado
description: Juicy ground turkey patties seasoned simply, topped with avocado and served on a wholemeal bun.
steps: Mix the turkey with garlic, paprika and seasoning, then form 4 patties.
Grill or pan-fry 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato and avocado.
notes: Turkey burgers dry out easily — do not overwork the meat when forming the patties.
